name: Board column sort methods + server-driven board queries
objective:
Feature: per-column sort method settings for task boards, plus removal of client-side chat listing/sorting/search/metrics for boards.

Requirements (from the user):
1. Each board column gets a `sort` setting with at least these values:
   - `last_changed`: most recently changed task on top (Chat.updated_at desc).
   - `unread`: most recently changed task that has unread messages on top (DEFAULT).
   - `manual`: user drag & drop ordering (Chat.sort_index).
2. Extra useful sort modes to include (analyst/implementer should validate and document them): `priority` (high>medium>low, then last_changed), `due_date` (earliest first, empty last), `created` (newest first), `cost` (highest first), `name` (A-Z) and `status`.
3. The setting must be persisted per column in the board catalogue (`.codx/tasks/boards/<board_id>/board.json`) and survive reload/rename, with a safe default for existing boards (`unread`).
4. Server side endpoints must return boards already sorted/paginated/filtered so the client never downloads every chat of a project (projects can hold thousands of chats). No client-side chat listing, sorting, searching or metric computation for boards.
5. Backwards compatible: existing boards/columns without the setting keep working; no data migration required beyond defaulting.

Known code anchors (verified in the working tree):
- `api/codx/junior/kanban/store.py::_normalize_columns` (~line 517) currently persists only `{id, title, color, folder, order, project_id, profiles}`; `_normalize_board` (~line 596) writes one `board.json` per board under a project-wide fcntl lock.
- `client/src/store/kanban.js`: `boardChats` (~441) and `buildViewColumns` (~470) build columns from `Object.values($storex.chats.chats)` and sort cards client-side (~497); `sprintColumns` (~566) does the same with `sortColumnTasks`; `moveTask` (~967), `moveSprintStatus` (~1031), `updateColumn` (~837), `syncColumnOrder` (~875).
- `api/codx/junior/db.py`: `Chat` has `updated_at`, `sort_index`, `priority`, `due_date`, `cost`, `created_at`; `Message.read_by` (list of usernames that have seen an assistant message) plus `POST /api/chats/markMessageAsSeen` are the current unread primitive (unread is computed in the browser today, e.g. ChatSidebar unread badge).
- `ChatManager.list_chats` (`api/codx/junior/chat_manager.py:481`) walks `.codx/tasks`, skips catalogue files via `is_store_file`, and loads chats with `chat_only=True` (last message only). `get_chat_file` (~245) resolves folders from the catalogue.
- Reference documentation of the model: `TASKS_BOARDS_SPRINTS.md` (§5 columns, §9.2 planning, §12.2 sprint column status is NOT persisted).

Objective achieved when: the sort setting round-trips through the kanban store, a server endpoint serves per-column paginated cards with server-side sorting/search and dataset-wide counters (including unread), the board UI persists/consumes the setting and no longer builds columns from the full client chat map, and the docs describe the contract.

steps.title: Persist per-column sort setting in the kanban store
steps.objective:
Each board column must persist a `sort` method in `.codx/tasks/boards/<board_id>/board.json`.

File: `api/codx/junior/kanban/store.py` (`_normalize_columns` ~line 517 currently persists only `{id, title, color, folder, order, project_id, profiles}`; `_normalize_board` ~596 writes one board.json per board under a project-wide fcntl lock).

1) Add module constants `COLUMN_SORT_METHODS = ("unread", "last_changed", "manual", "priority", "due_date", "created", "cost", "name", "status")`, `DEFAULT_COLUMN_SORT = "unread"`, and a helper `normalize_column_sort(value)` that returns a valid method (invalid/None -> `DEFAULT_COLUMN_SORT`).
2) Extend `_normalize_columns` so every column dict keeps its existing keys and gains `sort`. Resolution order: the incoming raw `sort`, else the value already stored on disk for that same column id in board.json, else `unread`. Never drop a column because of an invalid value.
3) Make sure the whole build/save path emits `sort` so it round-trips through `save_board`, board rename/resolution and `update_column` (find how columns are updated today; if columns are only written from the board document, no extra endpoint work is required here — the API step covers that).
4) Backwards compatibility: a board.json written by an older version (no `sort`) loads fine and exposes `unread`; nothing else in the document is rewritten except the added key. Keep JSON indent/format identical to today.
5) If `api/codx/junior/db.py` has a column model/dataclass used by the API layer, add an optional `sort: Optional[str] = None` field (old payloads stay valid).

Do not refactor unrelated board logic.

Acceptance: add `api/codx/junior/kanban/test_store_sort.py` (pytest, plain asserts) proving: (a) save a board with a column sort='manual' and reload it -> 'manual' on disk and through the store API; (b) a board.json without the key loads as 'unread'; (c) 'foo' loads as 'unread'; (d) a valid value survives board resolution by title. steps.title: Server-side board cards endpoint: sort, search, pagination, unread, counters
steps.objective:
Implement `GET /api/kanban/boards/{board_id}/columns/{column_id}/cards` exactly as specified in `docs/board-card-query-contract.md` (read that spec, `api/codx/junior/kanban/store.py` and the unread helper added in `api/codx/junior/chat_manager.py` first).

Rules:
- Resolve `board_id`/`column_id` through the existing catalogue helpers in `kanban/store.py` (boards are keyed by title; reuse the existing resolution and its error style). Unknown board/column -> same 404/HTTPException style as the neighbouring kanban endpoints.
- Effective sort: the `sort` query param when it is in `COLUMN_SORT_METHODS`, else the column's persisted `sort`, else `unread`.
- Selection limited to chats of that board+column using the catalogue + `ChatManager.list_chats(chat_only=True)` path; never read full message bodies for the whole dataset. Apply server-side `q` filter, then sort, then `offset`/`limit` (cap limit at 200).
- Response exactly per spec: `board_id`, `column_id`, `sort`, `total`, `unread_total`, `cards[]` (minimal projection incl. `unread`, `unread_count`), dataset-wide `counters` per column (`total`, `unread`) and `columns[].sort`, so the client can render headers without listing chats.
- Register the route next to the other `/api/kanban` routes (`grep -rn "api/kanban" api/codx/junior`), reusing their auth/permission decorators and error style.
- Performance guard: counting must come from a cheap metadata scan (no message bodies) and only the requested page's chats are hydrated; explain the approach in the docstring. Reuse the `chat_unread` helper for the unread flag/count and for `unread_total`/counters.

Acceptance: pytest `api/codx/junior/kanban/test_cards_endpoint.py` proving: (a) offset/limit paginate deterministically under `last_changed`; (b) `sort=manual` honours `sort_index`; (c) omitting `sort` uses the persisted column setting; (d) `q` filters case-insensitively; (e) `unread_total` and counters are consistent with the hydrated page; (f) a `limit=1` request hydrates a bounded number of chat files (assert with a monkeypatched loader counter). Report the commands run.

steps.title: Board UI: column sort selector, server totals and manual-only drag & drop
steps.objective:
Add the board UI for the column sort setting on top of the reworked `client/src/store/kanban.js`.

- Locate the board column/card components (`grep -rln "buildViewColumns\|boardChats\|column.title" client/src/components client/src/views`) and add a compact sort selector in the column header (menu or select) with readable labels: Unread (default), Last changed, Manual, Priority, Due date, Created, Cost, Name, Status. The current value comes from the server column metadata (`columns[].sort`).
- Changing it calls the `updateColumn` action with `{sort}` and refetches that column page; show the optimistic state.
- Card drag & drop reordering is enabled only when the column sort is `manual`; for automatic sorts render cards read-only (no drag handle / disabled drag) with a tooltip: 'Column is sorted automatically — switch to Manual to reorder'.
- Column header shows the server `total` / `unread_total` (never client-computed) and a 'load more' affordance wired to the paginated action while `cards.length < total`.

Reuse the existing UI library/classes and keep styling consistent with neighbouring components; no unrelated refactors.

Acceptance: `npm run build` (or the repo lint script) succeeds. In the step report describe: which request fires when switching a column to 'Last changed' (only the column page, no full chat map fetch), and that drag & drop is disabled for automatic sorts and enabled for Manual.

# ⛔ BLOCKED — no code was changed (orchestrator infrastructure bug)

## What happened
Zero worker steps ever executed. Both dispatch attempts (round 1 and the round-2 retry)
failed during **card creation**, before any worker started:

```
TaskManager.create_task() got an unexpected keyword argument 'estimation_cost'
```

- identical error for two different profiles (`software_developer` and `analyst`)
- reproduces deterministically on retry (`step_prepare_failed` in both rounds)
- nothing was read, written or committed by a worker; the repository is untouched

### Root cause & one-line fix
Call-site/signature skew in the card-creation path: either
`api/codx/junior/tasks/manager.py::create_task` must accept `estimation_cost`, or the
orchestrator's call site must stop passing it. Fix one of the two, then re-run this
objective verbatim (the plan below is unchanged in substance).

## What the feature needs (verified against the working tree, ready to implement)

### 1. Persistence — per-column `sort` setting
`api/codx/junior/kanban/store.py::KanbanStore._normalize_columns` (~517) currently keeps only
`{id, title, color, folder, order, project_id, profiles}` and **silently drops everything else**.
Add, with the same "explicit wins, omitted inherits" rule already used for `project_id`/`profiles`
(so an agent `create_column` or an old client cannot wipe it):

- `sort`: one of `COLUMN_SORT_METHODS`, default `"unread"`
- `sort_dir`: optional `"asc"|"desc"` (reserved, not required by the UI)
- unknown/missing value → normalise to `"unread"` (no migration; existing `board.json` default on read)

Constants belong in `api/codx/junior/kanban/model.py`. Must survive reload and column rename.

### 2. Sort modes (server-side comparators)
| value | order |
|---|---|
| `unread` **(default)** | unread first, newest `updated_at` first; then rest by `updated_at` desc |
| `last_changed` | `updated_at` desc |
| `manual` | `sort_index` asc (drag & drop), then `updated_at` desc |
| `priority` | high → medium → low, then `last_changed` |
| `due_date` | earliest first, tasks without `due_date` last |
| `created` | `created_at` desc |
| `cost` | `cost` desc |
| `name` | title A→Z |
| `status` | canonical `todo → doing → onhold → done → rejected`, then `last_changed` |

Cards must always end with a stable tie-breaker (chat id) so pagination is deterministic.

### 3. Unread without browser computation
Today unread lives only in the browser (`Message.read_by` + `POST /api/chats/markMessageAsSeen`).
Opening every message per board request is not viable at thousands of chats, so:
- denormalise `unread_counts` onto `Chat`, maintained by `ChatManager` and the mark-as-seen path
- fall back to computing from `read_by` for legacy chats lacking the field
- one server helper `is_unread(chat, user)` shared by the endpoint and the counters

### 4. Server board query (replaces the client chat map)
`GET /api/kanban/boards/{board_id}/cards` (or `POST .../columns/{column_id}/cards`) returning per column:
- `items[]` — lightweight `ChatSummary` (id, title, column, priority, due_date, cost, updated_at, created_at, sort_index, unread, assignee/profiles) — **no message bodies**
- `page` / `page_size` / `next_cursor` (per-column pagination, default ~50)
- `total`, `unread_total`, `cost_total` computed over the **whole dataset**, not the page
- query params: `q` (search on title/user), `priority`, `assignee`, `profile`, `due` filters
- `sort` read from the column setting (per-request override allowed), applied server-side
- reuse `ChatManager.list_chats` (walks `.codx/tasks`, `is_store_file`, `chat_only=True`) and avoid N+1 hydration

### 5. Client (`client/src/store/kanban.js`)
- `buildViewColumns` (~470) / `boardChats` (~441) / `sprintColumns` (~566) stop mapping
  `Object.values($storex.chats.chats)` and stop sorting inline (~497 via `sortColumnTasks`)
- state holds per-column `{items, total, unread_total, cost_total, loaded}`; "load more" appends a page
- column settings UI gets a **Sort** select persisted through `updateColumn` (~837) → `saveBoard`
- `sort_index` writes happen **only** for `manual` columns on drop (`moveTask` ~967, `moveSprintStatus` ~1031), batched
- search/filter move to request params; no client-side metric aggregation for boards

### 6. Docs
`TASKS_BOARDS_SPRINTS.md` §5 (column schema + `sort`), §9.2 (planning), new "Column sort & board queries"
section, §9 read-models/counters, §13 (endpoints); plus a page under `docs/features/`.

## Acceptance (unchanged, for the re-run)
1. `board.json` round-trips `sort`; existing boards read as `unread`; pytest covers round-trip, default, unknown value, rename.
2. Endpoint returns sorted/paginated/filtered cards + dataset-wide `total`/`unread_total`/`cost_total`; a test with >1 page asserts page 2 and totals are not page-scoped.
3. Client builds columns only from the endpoint response; grep shows no `Object.values($storex.chats.chats)` in board column building.
4. Docs describe the nine modes and the endpoint contract.

**Recommendation:** fix the `estimation_cost` call-site bug and restart this run — the plan
(8 steps, store → contract → unread → endpoint → client store → client UI → docs → verify)
is sound and needs no redesign.
